fields.text: Make a five-second ambient loop concept: Muse draws the first frame ($0.01), MiniMax H3 Spicy animates one small movement (480p, $0.20). This model supports image-to-video; the scene is a simple product still. Change the still and motion briefs together. Inspect temporal stability; a seamless loop is not guaranteed.

A matte charcoal Volt pocket night-ride radio on rain-slick wet asphalt at night. Sharp electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron on the face, no letters. Close three-quarter view, entire radio visible, clear silhouette. Magenta neon from camera-left, cyan bounce in the puddle, faint rain beads on the shell. No text, logos or people.

Locked camera for five seconds. Thin rain beads slide slowly down the radio's charcoal shell. Magenta and cyan neon shimmer in the puddle. The radio and asphalt remain completely still. Preserve their shape and placement; no cuts, new objects or camera motion.
